description: Write the Last Price integration code for an app (Next.js, Express or FastAPI): a client that records signals, prices calls, creates customers and bills them through Stripe, plus an example, as files and one patch for git apply. Writes nothing anywhere. Early access. Needs a Last Price credential with billing read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

agent_id.description: One of your agents, filled into the code.

customers.description: Include creating customers at sign-up (default true).

event_name.description: The billable event the example records, like chat.completed.

name: generate_monetization_code
